recent_posts.title: Cisco Networking App Marketplace Partners at Cisco Live 2026
recent_posts.summary: Cisco Live US 2026 will feature 24 Cisco Networking App Marketplace partners across five solution areas: wireless and network optimization, network operations and automation, security and policy management, infrastructure and connectivity, and specialized solutions. Partners include Red Hat, Ekahau, BlueCAT, Megaport, IP Fabric, Zabbix, Claroty, and others. The event includes over 15 expert-led sessions covering topics like AI-driven network operations, Wi-Fi 7 design, zero-trust policy automation, and Ansible-based automation. Partners will be present across the World of Solutions, Security Village, Networking Village, and Collaboration Village.

recent_posts.title: Beyond the Pilot: Building the Clinical Data Fabric for the Agentic Era
recent_posts.summary: A Cisco CX executive reflects on a panel about scaling AI in healthcare, arguing that the industry is entering an 'Agentic Era' where AI systems act autonomously rather than just summarizing data. The core thesis is that the bottleneck is no longer algorithmic but infrastructural: healthcare data is too large to move efficiently, so compute must be brought to the data at the point of care. This requires rethinking the network as a 'clinical data fabric' with low-latency architecture, end-to-end observability, predictive operations, and zero-trust security. The piece frames agentic AI as a solution to clinician burnout by offloading administrative cognitive load.

recent_posts.title: Month of Developer Productivity: Build and Forget
recent_posts.summary: A Cisco engineer shares a 'build and forget' philosophy for developer productivity through a four-part video series. The series covers: setting up VS Code with Remote SSH and Dev Containers, configuring formatters (Black, Prettier) and linters (Ruff, Pylint) with type checkers (Pylance, ty), debugging Python with launch.json and VS Code debugger tools, and achieving reproducible builds using uv combined with Makefiles and Docker containers.

recent_posts.title: The race to autonomous transport networks: A new study
recent_posts.summary: A Cisco and Ciena-commissioned Omdia white paper examines how 80 global communications service providers (CSPs) are transitioning from manual CLI-driven processes to AI-driven autonomous transport networks. Key findings: 79% of CSPs already see AI services generating higher traffic volumes, 61% are still in early automation stages but 56% expect semi-autonomous or fully autonomous networks within three years, and 47% view agentic AI as critical to their three-year strategy. Top use cases include live performance optimization, troubleshooting, and predictive analytics. 64% plan to deploy digital twins before rolling out AI features to production. The report also addresses workforce implications, with some CSPs anticipating up to a 30% reduction in roles reliant on manual processes.

recent_posts.title: How AI simplifies wireless network management for lean IT teams
recent_posts.summary: Growing businesses face a wireless management crisis: lean IT teams are overwhelmed by rising complexity, reactive troubleshooting, and security demands. Key data from the Cisco State of Wireless 2026 report shows 98% of wireless leaders report growing operational complexity, 65% spend most time on reactive troubleshooting, and 85% experienced a wireless security incident in the past year. AI-driven management is presented as the scalable solution — automating root-cause analysis, providing proactive network health monitoring, and reducing manual configuration tasks. Cisco's AI-powered platforms, including AgenticOps and centralized dashboards, are positioned as tools to help small IT teams manage Wi-Fi 6E/7 environments without adding headcount or complexity.

recent_posts.title: Biochar’s triple win: Healthier soils, improved crops, and decarbonization
recent_posts.summary: Biochar — produced by heating organic matter in low-oxygen conditions (pyrolysis) — is gaining traction as both a carbon removal tool and a soil health solution. The market hit $1.7B in 2023 and is growing at 13%+ annually. The Cisco Foundation's Regenerative Future Fund backs two early-stage companies: Applied Carbon (US), which converts corn stover, wheat straw, and sugarcane waste into biochar, and Poas Bioenergy (Costa Rica), which processes wet tropical residues like coffee and pineapple waste. Both use decentralized, modular pyrolysis systems that operate on-site at farms, reducing logistics costs and making biochar accessible to smallholder farmers. Biochar accounts for roughly 90% of all durable carbon removal credits and offers co-benefits including improved water retention, higher crop yields, and reduced methane emissions from agricultural waste.

recent_posts.title: Designing a Proactive Customer Journey
recent_posts.summary: Sunset Learning Institute, a Cisco Platinum Learning Partner, examined its own class registration process and found that while functional, it relied on reactive support when students missed communications. The proposed improvement is a proactive customer journey starting with SMS reminders sent via Webex Connect on the first day of class, including a direct meeting join link. Webex Connect is highlighted as a low-code CPaaS platform enabling multi-channel automation with CRM integrations and AI agent capabilities. The broader lesson is to start with a specific friction point, send fewer but better-timed messages, and build toward omnichannel orchestration incrementally.

recent_posts.title: Modernize your data center operations with Cisco Nexus Dashboard
recent_posts.summary: Cisco Nexus Dashboard 4.2 introduces several key capabilities for modern data center operations. The release adds AI job monitoring via Slurm integration for real-time visibility into HPC and AI workloads, LLDP-based adaptive routing with NVIDIA NICs, and Dynamic Load Balancing on Cisco Silicon One platforms. A major security addition is Live Protect for NX-OS, which uses eBPF to deploy zero-downtime kernel-level vulnerability mitigations without reboots. Platform flexibility expands with support for virtual deployments on Nutanix and AWS, a new G5L large appliance supporting 1,000 switches in a 3-node cluster, and native Splunk integration for extended observability. The Nexus One strategy unifies management across on-premises, colocation, and sovereign cloud environments.

recent_posts.title: How Cisco Agentic Workflows orchestrates Ansible, Terraform, and Python for network automation
recent_posts.summary: Cisco Agentic Workflows is positioned as an orchestration layer that unifies existing automation tools like Ansible, Terraform, and Python scripts into a cohesive enterprise-grade platform. Rather than replacing current tooling, it adds a visual low-/no-code designer, human-in-the-loop approval gates, centralized audit logging, ITSM/IPAM integrations, and AI-driven workflow assistance. A network lifecycle replacement example illustrates how fragmented manual tasks become a governed, outcome-driven process. The platform is included with any active Cisco network management console license, with a free Meraki account available to get started.

recent_posts.title: Try Cisco AI Defense Explorer Edition in this hands-on lab
recent_posts.summary: Cisco AI Defense Explorer Edition is an agentic red-teaming tool that adapts attacks across multiple conversation turns to test AI models and applications before deployment. A hands-on DevNet lab (~40 minutes) walks through connecting a customer support assistant target, running a Quick Scan with a custom objective focused on hidden instruction disclosure, and reviewing findings including Attack Success Rate across 14 risk categories, custom goals, and system prompt extraction results.
